senses.gloss:
गोपन, अम्, n. guarding, protecting, protection,
preservation; hiding, concealment; reviling, abuse;
flurry, hurry, alarm; light, lustre; the leaf of the
Laurus Cassia, = तमाल-पत्त्र; (आ), f. protection.
गोपन गोपन, &c. See under rt. गुप्.

गोपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be preserved or pro-
tected; to be prevented; to be concealed or hidden;
secret, mysterious.
—गोपनीय-ता, f. or गोपनीय-
त्व, अम्, n. concealableness, fitness for being kept
secret.
गोपयत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be protected.

गोपायक, अस्, ई, अम्, a preserver, a cherisher,
one who guards or protects.

गोपायन, अस्, आ, अम्, preserving, protecting;
(अम्), n. protecting, preserving, protection.

गोपायित, अस्, आ, अम्, preserved, protected, che-
rished.
गोपायितृ, ता, m. a preserver, a protector.

गोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, a protector, one who preserves
or protects; (इनी), f., N. of a creeping plant, Ichno-
carpus Frutescens; [cf. गोपी and गोपिका.]
गोपिल, अस्, आ, अम्, one who preserves or protects.
गोपिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. superl. of गोप्तृ.
गोप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or preserved.

गोप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a preserver, a protector, one
who defends or cherishes; one who conceals any-
thing.

गोप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or preserved;
to be kept, to be taken care of; to be kept secret or
hidden; to be cherished; (अस्), m. a servant, a
slave; the son of a female slave; an assemblage of
cowherdesses (? n.).
—गोप्याधि (˚य-आधि), इस्, m. a
pledge which is not to be used but carefully preserved.
गोप्यक, अस्, m. a slave, a servant.

गोप गो-प, अस्, m. (fr. गो and rt. पा), a
cowherd, a herdsman, a milkman, considered as a
man of mixed caste; the chief of a cow-pen or
station; a protector, a guardian, a preserver, a
cherisher, a helper, a friend or patron; the super-
intendent of several villages, the head of a district;
a king; the chief herdsman, i. e. Kṛṣṇa; N. of a
Gandharva [cf. गो-पति]; N. of a Buddhist Arhat;
N. of a mountain; myrrh, = गोप-रस; (आ), f.
= गोपी, the plant Ichnocarpus Frutescens; N. of one
of the wives of Śākya-muni; (ई), f. the wife of a
cowherd, see below; [cf. गो-पा, अहि-गोप, इन्द्र-ग्˚,
कुल-ग्˚, त्रिदश-ग्˚, सुरेन्द्र-ग्˚.]
—गोप-कन्या,
f. the daughter of a cowherd; a nymph of Vṛndā-
vana; the plant Ichnocarpus Frutescens.
—गोप-कर्-
कटिका, f. = गोपाल-कर्कती.
—गोप-घोण्टा, f., N.
of a plant, = हस्तिकोलि, commonly शेयाकुल, a wild
sort of jujube, Zizyphus Nepeca or Zizyphus Œnoplia.
—गोप-जीविन्, ई, m., N. of a mixed caste.
—गोप-
ता, f. the office of a herdsman.
—गोप-दत्त, अस्,
m., N. of a Buddhist author.
—गोप-दल, अस्, m.
the betel-nut or areca tree.
—गोप-बधू or गोप-
वधू, ऊस्, f. a cowherd's wife; the plant Ichnocarpus
Frutescens (शारिवा); [cf. गोप-कन्या.]
—गोप-
बधूटी, f. the youthful wife of a cowherd.
—गोप-
भद्र, अम्, n. the fibrous root of a water-lily
(शालूक); (आ), f. the plant Gmelina Arborea, [cf.
[]
काश्मरी]; also गोप-भद्रिका.
—गोप-रस, अस्,
m. gum myrrh, myrrh; [cf. गो-प and रस.]
—गोप-
राष्ट्र, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—गो-परीणस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. abundantly furnished with cattle or
milk.
—गोप-वन, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi of the
family of Atri.
—गोप-वल्ली, f. the plant Ichnocarpus
Frutescens (अनन्ता); Sanseviera Zeylanica (मूर्वा).
—गोप-वेश or गोप-वेष, अस्, आ, अम्, dressed
as a herdsman.
—गोपाटविक, अस्, m. a cowherd
(fr. गोप, a herd, and आटविक, a forester?).
—गो-
पादित्य (˚प-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king of Kaś-
mīra; N. of a poet.
—गोपाध्यक्ष (˚प-अध्˚),
अस्, m. an overseer of herdsmen, the chief of herds-
men.
—गोपानसी (˚प-अन्˚), f. the wood of a
thatch, a curved beam which supports it; the bam-
boo frame-work on which it rests.
—गोपेन्द्र (˚प-
इन्˚), अस्, m. the chief of the herdsmen, an epithet
of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu.
—गोपेश (˚प-ईश), अस्, m.
a chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine; an
epithet of Kṛṣṇa; also of Nanda, the foster-father
of Kṛṣṇa; also of Śākya-muni.

गो-पा, आस्, m., Ved. a herdsman, a protector, a
guardian; [cf. गो-प, देव-गोपा, वात-ग्˚, वायु-ग्˚,
सह-ग्˚, सु-ग्˚, सोम-ग्˚.]
—गोपा-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. one who has the tongue, i. e. the voice of a
cowherd; (Sāy.) an epithet of Indra.
—गोपा-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. granting protection.

गोपी, f. a cowherd's wife (especially applied to
the cowherdesses of Vṛndā-vana, the companions of
Kṛṣṇa's juvenile sports, who are considered some-
times as holy or celestial personages); a milkmaid;
a protectress; nature, elementary nature; the plant
Ichnocarpus Frutescens.
—गोपी-चन्दन, अम्, n. a
species of white clay said to be brought from
Dvārakā and used by Viṣṇu's worshippers for
smearing their face.
—गोपी-चन्दनोपनिषद् (˚न-
उप्˚), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

गोपालव गोपालव, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
warrior-tribe; (for गोपालक?).

गोपुटा गोपुटा, f. large cardamoms; [cf.
पुटिका.]

गोपाय, Nom. A. गोपायते, to act like a herds-
man.
